# Pinned Three.js distribution

three-0.180.0.tgz was built with `npm pack` from official mrdoob/three.js tag r180, commit 0af9729d0c143a86a1d725d6e2c3ad83301f3f34. MIT license is included in the package. Vendored for reproducible/offline installation because the npm registry was unavailable in the execution environment. Runtime assets are bundled by Astro/Vite; no CDN dependency.
